create_gopher_repetition_filter: create a GopherRepetitionFilter instance to filter documents with configurable repetition thresholds
test_filter_document: test the GopherRepetitionFilter.filter method on a Document to detect duplicate paragraphs, lines, and n-grams
build_n_grams_list: build a list of n-grams from a list of words using the get_n_grams function
find_duplicate_elements: find duplicate elements and their character counts in a list using the find_duplicates function
find_all_duplicate_n_grams: find all repeated n-gram character counts in a word list using the find_all_duplicate function
